name: Awakener's Orb
description:
Destroys an item, applying its influence to another of the same item class
The second item is reforged as a rare item with both influence types and new modifiers
directions: Right click this item, then left click the item you wish to take the influence from, then left click an item of the same item class you wish to apply it to.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on the item you wish to take the influence from, then A on an item of the same item class you wish to apply it to.
